title: Pokémon the Series: XY
synopsis: This began with only Ash Ketchum, headed off to Kalos region with his Pikachu while wearing a new set of clothes, intending to challenge the Kalos League. Joining him this time are Serena, a new Trainer who previously met Ash in her childhood; Clemont, an aspiring inventor and scientist, who is also the Gym Leader of the Lumiose Gym; and Bonnie, Clemont's younger sister. Jessie, James and Meowth continue to follow Ash and his friends through the Kalos region, and have gone back to their more traditional methods of capturing Ash's Pikachu and other Pokémon. This series includes XY, Kalos Quest & XYZ arcs
